title: Hold an asbestos removal licence
what: Hold (or work for a holder of) a Class A licence to do Class A asbestos removal work, and a Class A or B licence to do Class B work.

sources.title: Occupational Health and Safety Regulations 2017 (Vic)
sources.publisher: Victorian Legislation (authorised version saved by the owner)
sources.locator: r 264 (S.R. No. 22/2017, authorised version 018, saved by the owner)
sources.quote: A person must not perform Class A asbestos removal work unless that person— (a) holds a Class A asbestos removal licence;

sources.title: Occupational Health and Safety Regulations 2017 (Vic)
sources.publisher: Victorian Legislation (authorised version saved by the owner)
sources.locator: r 265 (S.R. No. 22/2017, authorised version 018, saved by the owner)
sources.quote: A person must not perform Class B asbestos removal work unless that person— (a) holds a Class A asbestos removal licence or a Class B asbestos removal licence;

administration.note: Issues asbestos removal licences and enforces the duty.

sources.title: Summary of the OHS Act 2004: General OHS Duties
sources.locator: Duties of employers to employees and contractors (section 21)
sources.quote: The OHS Act requires all employers to provide and maintain a working environment that is safe and without risks to health. This duty is to be met so far as is reasonably practicable.

triggers.note: When the business removes friable asbestos, or more than 10 square metres of non-friable asbestos.

reach.note: Any business that removes asbestos; mostly demolition, construction trades and specialist asbestos removalists.

confidence_note: Quoted from the authorised PDF the owner saved from the Victorian register (data/raw/vic_legislation/, not committed); the register's documents disallow automated fetching. Victoria defines Class A and Class B asbestos removal work in its own regulations.

assessment.summary: Removing friable asbestos, or more than 10 square metres of non-friable asbestos, needs a class A or class B asbestos removal licence held by the business doing it.

marks.reason: A licence, with qualified supervisors and set procedures, is needed before a business can take on asbestos removal work.

assessment.confidence_note: Marked from the licence's design against the framework's guide; the health benefit is not counted by the framework.
